picks.editorial_note: A $334 million grant to build a new national supercomputing system is one of the largest single AI-infrastructure investments of the year, dramatically expanding shared access to advanced computing for scientific discovery.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: AI-designed bacteriophages were used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection, a genuine breakthrough demonstrating AI's ability to design functional biological therapies with immediate clinical stakes.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's entry into the Schmidt Science Computing Network, anchored by a major grant establishing the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, signals a coordinated national push to pair elite AI compute with frontier science.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: An independent machine-learning technique that confirmed the iconic Event Horizon Telescope image of the M87 black hole, published in Nature, is a notable validation of AI's growing role in fundamental physics.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a national-security scandal is a seismic event for the AI industry, triggering a government investigation and leadership uncertainty at the company whose chips underpin nearly all frontier AI research.
picks.title: Nvidia seeks successor after Jensen Huang's exit wobbles AI industry

picks.editorial_note: A further $19 million state grant to Texas Tech for a semiconductor-AI computing cluster reflects the growing state-level investment race in domestic chip and compute capacity tied to AI research.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: Research showing AI models can predict materials' electronic structures with far less training data than assumed could substantially lower the cost and barrier to AI-accelerated materials discovery across the field.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and France's CNRS launching a joint international laboratory applying AI to metabolic disease research marks a significant cross-border academic-government partnership with direct global-health applications.
picks.title: Metabolism, AI and global health: Imperial and France's CNRS celebrate launch of joint laboratory

picks.editorial_note: A new MIT quantization method addressing the KV cache memory bottleneck in large language models, headed for presentation at NeurIPS, tackles a core efficiency constraint limiting how AI systems can be deployed at scale.
picks.title: Faster data compression through quantization

picks.editorial_note: A pointed critique from University of Amsterdam legal scholars that the EU's proposed Cloud and AI Development Act doesn't go far enough highlights an active, consequential policy debate over Europe's digital sovereignty from US cloud and AI providers.
picks.title: 'EU plan for cloud and AI falls short on digital autonomy'
